ablation_steps.name: Baseline OCR
ablation_steps.description: Raw OCR without character repair or entity resolution

ablation_steps.name: + OCR Normalization
ablation_steps.description: Adds digit substitution (O/0, l/1, S/5) and admin keyword repair

ablation_steps.name: + Region Segmentation
ablation_steps.description: Segments target address bounding box and strips extraneous invoice noise

ablation_steps.name: + PIN-First Recovery
ablation_steps.description: Infers missing or noisy administrative entities from validated 6-digit PIN

ablation_steps.name: + Multilingual Robustness
ablation_steps.description: Adds Devanagari numeral conversion and Indic prefix/abbreviation parsing (जि., ता.)

ablation_steps.name: + Full Verification Core
ablation_steps.description: Full GeoVerify multi-source candidate generation, ranking, and decision engine
